User: I'm seeking legal guidance. I'm involved in a personal injury claim matter. My attorney Amy Foster from Caldwell Legal has been handling things; we're scheduled in immigration court. iven our mediation is in three weeks, what are the most likely questions the mediator or opposing counsel will ask regarding the intersection of the personal injury claim and our financial/custody details?
